rationale: Third-party bodily injury (neighbor's child with broken wrist) arising from a hazardous condition on the policyholder's premises (icy walkway).
claim_summary: On the neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on the icy walkway in front of the policyholder's house during an ice storm last week and broke her wrist. Medical bills from treatment are anticipated. This is a high-severity pediatric injury claim within the policy's liability coverage limits.

case_facts.cause: slip and fall on icy walkway
